info.name: Marketplace API · Payroll
info.description:
End-to-end payroll API tests: admin/staff setup, employee enrollment, monthly payroll runs, payslip adjustment, approval + payment, employee self-service, and negative cases.

HOW TO USE
1. Start the app (default port 8081) against a migrated database. Flyway V9 seeds the payroll permissions and the admin account (admin@example.com / 12345678).
2. Import this collection and run it with the Collection Runner (top to bottom).
3. Requests store tokens and ids in collection variables automatically; no manual copying.

The flow is stateful and intended for a fresh dev database. Running it twice against the same database will fail on duplicate enrollment / duplicate payroll period, because payroll history is immutable by design. To re-run, reset the database or change the period variables (periodYear/periodMonth, spareYear/spareMonth, emptyRunYear/emptyRunMonth, currencyRunYear/currencyRunMonth).

PERMISSION MATRIX
- ROLE_ADMIN / ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN: payroll:read, payroll:manage, payroll:approve
- ROLE_HR: payroll:read, payroll:manage
- ROLE_MANAGER: payroll:read, payroll:approve
- ROLE_EMPLOYEE: none of the staff payroll permissions; only self-service (/payroll/me/**).

ENDPOINTS COVERED
POST /api/v1/auth/login
GET|POST /api/v1/admin/users
GET /api/v1/users/me
GET|POST /api/v1/payroll/employees
GET|PUT /api/v1/payroll/employees/{userId}
PATCH /api/v1/payroll/employees/{userId}/status
GET|POST /api/v1/payroll/runs
GET /api/v1/payroll/runs/{id}
POST /api/v1/payroll/runs/{id}/regenerate
POST /api/v1/payroll/runs/{id}/approve
POST /api/v1/payroll/runs/{id}/pay
POST /api/v1/payroll/runs/{id}/cancel
GET /api/v1/payroll/runs/{id}/payslips
GET|PATCH /api/v1/payroll/payslips/{id}
GET /api/v1/payroll/me/profile
GET /api/v1/payroll/me/payslips
GET /api/v1/payroll/me/payslips/{id}
GET /api/v1/notifications

item.name: 00 · Setup (admin + staff accounts)
item.description: Creates the four test accounts (HR, MANAGER, EMPLOYEE, regular user) with the admin account, logs each of them in, and stores their user ids. Staff creation accepts 409 so it is safe if the accounts already exist.

request.description: Seeded admin: admin@example.com / 12345678. Stores the JWT in {{adminToken}}.
Requires admin:access. ROLE_HR receives payroll:read + payroll:manage.
ROLE_MANAGER receives payroll:read + payroll:approve (can approve/pay but not edit).
The employee to enroll and pay. Has no staff payroll permissions, only self-service access.
A regular authenticated user who is not enrolled in payroll, used to prove self-service isolation (404).
Stores the HR JWT in {{hrToken}}.
Captures the HR user id in {{hrUserId}}.
Stores the manager JWT in {{managerToken}}.
Captures the manager user id in {{managerUserId}}.
Stores the employee JWT in {{employeeToken}}.
Captures the employee user id in {{employeeUserId}}; it is used for enrollment and payslip lookup.
Stores the outsider JWT in {{outsiderToken}}.
Captures the outsider user id in {{outsiderUserId}}.

item.name: 01 · Employee profiles
item.description: Enrolls the employee (HR only), exercises listing/filtering, updates compensation, and toggles employment status.

request.description: Requires payroll:manage. Omitting employeeCode auto-generates EMP-<userId>. Stores the code in {{employeeCode}}.
One payroll profile per user.
Method security rejects payroll:manage before any business logic runs.
Paged list (default size 20, max 100, sorted by id desc).
q matches employee code, username, or full name.

exec: pm.test('all items in Operations', () => pm.expect(items.every(i => i.department === 'Operations')).to.eql(true));

request.description: Optional status (ACTIVE | ON_LEAVE | TERMINATED) and department filters, case-insensitive department match.
Manager has payroll:read only; reading compensation is allowed, editing is not.
Requires payroll:manage. baseSalary is required on every update; other fields are optional.
ON_LEAVE employees are still eligible for payroll (only TERMINATED is excluded).
Restores the employee before generating the payroll run.

item.name: 02 · Payroll runs and payslips
item.description: Creates the monthly run, validates duplicate/future-period/currency rules, captures the employee payslip, and adjusts it while still in DRAFT.

exec: pm.test('one payslip generated for the employee', () => pm.expect(Number(d.totalGross)).to.be.at.least(1100));
pm.test('net equals gross minus deductions', () => pm.expect(Number(d.totalNet)).to.be.closeTo(Number(d.totalGross) - Number(d.totalDeductions), 0.001));

request.description: Requires payroll:manage. Period must not be in the future; one run per year+month. Payslips are generated for ACTIVE/ON_LEAVE employees whose currency matches the run. Stores {{runId}}.
Unique constraint on (period_year, period_month).
The pre-request script sets {{futureYear}} to next year, so this stays correct over time.
Requires payroll:read.
Manager read access includes run totals but not payslip editing.
Snapshots employee name/code/title/base/allowance. Stores the employee payslip id in {{payslipId}}.
Internal payslip detail; requires payroll:read.
Requires payroll:manage and a DRAFT run. gross = base + allowance + bonus + overtime; deductions = tax + otherDeductions; net = gross - deductions.
Net pay cannot go negative.
Run totals are recalculated after every payslip edit.
All enrolled employees are USD, so an EUR run is rejected instead of mixing currencies. This period must have no existing run.

item.name: 03 · Approval and payment
item.description: Enforces separation of duties: HR can build but not approve; MANAGER can approve/pay but not edit. Approval freezes the run.

request.description: Requires payroll:approve.
DRAFT → APPROVED. The run must contain at least one payslip.
Only DRAFT runs can be edited or regenerated.
Approval is a one-way transition from DRAFT.
APPROVED → PAID. Each employee with a payslip receives a PAYROLL notification.

exec: pm.test('only approved runs can be paid', () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));

request.description: PAID is terminal.
Payment sends one PAYROLL notification per payslip.

item.name: 04 · Employee self-service
item.description: Employees only see their own payslips, and only once the run is APPROVED or PAID. Outsiders get 404.

request.description: /payroll/me/** only needs authentication, not a payroll permission.

exec: pm.test('own payslip visible after approval', () => pm.expect(d.items.some(i => String(i.id) === target)).to.eql(true));

request.description: DRAFT and CANCELLED payslips are hidden from self-service.
Only the owning user can read the payslip.
Scoped by user id; another user's id returns 404, not 403, to avoid leaking existence.
No payroll profile means 404.
The internal endpoint requires payroll:read; employees must use /payroll/me/payslips/{id}.

item.name: 05 · Draft lifecycle (regenerate / cancel)
item.description: Uses a spare historical period so regenerate and cancel do not disturb the approved run.

request.description: Change spareYear/spareMonth if that period already has a run.
Deletes existing payslips and regenerates from current profiles. Draft only; manual adjustments are lost.
DRAFT → CANCELLED.

exec: pm.test('cancelled run cannot be approved', () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));

request.description: Only DRAFT runs transition to APPROVED.
Cancelling does not delete payslip history.

item.name: 06 · Negative and optional (run last)
item.description: Authorization negatives, validation, 404 lookups, and the termination scenario. The last two requests assume the enrolled employee is the only payable profile, so they may not hold on a database with other active employees.

request.description: Staff endpoints are not exposed to ROLE_EMPLOYEE.
Separation of duties: approvers cannot alter payslips.
Bean Validation rejects the request before the service runs.
ResourceNotFoundException maps to 404.
TERMINATED profiles are excluded from new payroll runs. This mutates the test employee, so it is last.
Only valid when no other ACTIVE/ON_LEAVE USD profile exists. The failed request creates nothing, so the period stays free for future runs. Change emptyRunYear/emptyRunMonth if needed.
